mentor: In the multi-agent debate paradigm, several LLM agents generate candidate answers and critique one another across one or more rounds. Representative studies illustrate both the potential and the limits of this design. For example, \citet{du2024multiagent_debate} report improved factuality and reasoning performance on the tasks they evaluate, whereas divergent prompting can mitigate convergence toward similar reasoning paths \citep{liang2024divergent_debate}. among agents.

community and the Linux Foundation, laying a foundation for heterogeneous
multi-agent QA systems.
